text:
maria: Quick ask — can someone grab a minimal nsys + torch.profiler capture for the canary that regressed token latency? Repro is batch=1 seq=1024, short loop. I ran a full trace and it's enormous. Looking for ~8-10s capture and a flamegraph for the hot path. cc @kevin

kevin: on it. can you paste the exact repro command and model variant? also preferred device/queue?

maria: repro: `python tools/run_infer.py --model rdl/opt-6.7b-qlora --batch 1 --seq 1024 --prompt-file samples/small.txt --iters 5 --device cuda`
capture plan: nsys for 10s then torch.profiler in nvtx/record_shapes mode. want json+flamegraph that surfaces KV misses and kernel hotspots.

kevin: got it. i'll run on rtx-6000 in perf-queue and trim to the steady window. if nsys qdrep is huge i'll export flame data only.

dev-bot: perf-queue: job queued (id: 7892) ETA ~12m

anya: tiny reminder: wrap model call with `with torch.profiler.profile(record_shapes=True, with_stack=False, use_cuda=True) as p:` and optionally `with torch.autograd.profiler.emit_nvtx():` so NSYS picks up NVTX ranges for KV/cache. also set `torch.profiler.tensorboard_trace_handler(...)` to collect the trace. :+1:

leo: export tip: if the .qdrep is big, run `nsys export --input trace.qdrep --output flame.json --format=flamegraph` to get a compact flamegraph json. speedscope also works. i can host the small flamejson on s3.

kevin: capture complete. raw artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/tmp/3129753100/trace_raw.qdrep (1.8GB) and s3://redwood-perf/tmp/3129753100/torchprof (20MB). i'll trim to ~8s around the first generation token and export flamejson.

maria: perfect — if you can pin the segment around the first KV miss (~200ms into generation) that helps narrow the prefetch/warmup issue.

kevin: trimmed and uploaded -> s3://redwood-perf/fg/3129753100/flamefold.json. also added the short nsys command i used to the upload.

kevin: snippet used:
```bash
nsys profile --output trace --force --sample=cpu --duration=10 --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --capture-start=0
```

maria: fetching the flamefold now, will attach to PERF-2213 and paste quick observations. if the flame shows suspicious K80 kernel waits i'll ask for a microrepro.

leo: looks good from my side. if anyone wants to pair on reading the flamegraph ping me in threads/bench-readout.

anya: tl;dr: nsys+torchprof captured, trimmed, flamejson uploaded, job id 7892 :party_parrot:

maria: thanks all :heart:
